item.title: Reading the Wind
item.description: The proverb isogaba maware was born on Lake Biwa: when the wind is bad, the long bridge at Seta beats the fast boat from Yabase. On choosing research topics, reading currents, and the people who walk toward Seta while the lake is still quiet.
